title: Workflow: intent → predict → sandbox → review → receipt
intro: One frame per stage, left to right. Each frame says what goes in it and starts empty: nothing here is an example, and nothing on this board runs anything.

frames.name: Intent
frames.guide: What you want done, in your own words: the outcome, its limits, and how you will know it worked.

frames.name: Predict
frames.guide: What you expect before anything runs: what changes, how long it takes, what it may cost. Each line stays a prediction until a check confirms it.

frames.name: Sandbox
frames.guide: Where a trial runs and what it may touch. Put the job or run id here once one exists; until then this frame stays empty.

frames.name: Review
frames.guide: What the trial did beside what was predicted: each difference, and whether you accept it. What is not known stays marked unknown.

frames.name: Receipt
frames.guide: The receipt of the accepted run (its short hash, from Timmy). A receipt proves what ran and who signed it, not that the result is right.
